stories.title: ClinicalTrials.gov API Adapter with Recruiting Filter
stories.description: Implement a dedicated adapter within clinical_trials_service to construct and execute ClinicalTrials.gov queries with enforced RECRUITING status filter, including parameter normalization and response parsing.

stories.title: Travel Distance Computation Batching and Optimization
stories.description: Enhance travel distance and duration computation using Google Routes by batching multiple trial locations per request where possible and implementing fallback logic when routing API limits or failures occur.

stories.title: Resilient Error Handling for External APIs
stories.description: Implement structured error handling for ClinicalTrials.gov and Google Routes API failures, including timeouts, partial results return, and logging via debug_logger without breaking the user flow.
